messages:
Ana P: Heads up — ran the FP8 enablement bake on the new 13B checkpoint, H100 vs L40S. Seeing weird accuracy dips for longer-context prompts (~4-6%) on H100 only. Anyone else?
Samir: Yep noticed similar on local CI yesterday. Short prompts were fine. Looks like a mixed-precision path is triggered somewhere for seq_len > 1024.
Miguel: Do you have the exact config you used? batch_size, seq_len distribution?
Ana P: batch_size=8, seq_lens sampled {32,128,512,2048}, tile=128, fp8-mode=auto, kv-cache enabled. Command: `python -m torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 serve.py --model X --quant fp8 --tile 128`
Samir: Quick hypothesis: H100 driver/compute may be promoting some matmuls to fp16 kernels when shapes cross a threshold, while L40S uses the AWQ kernel path and stays in fp8. That promotion can change activation scaling -> accuracy delta.
Liam: Can you paste a tiny repro? If it's shape-triggered we should see it in profiler. Run with `TORCH_USE_CUDA_DSA=1` and capture `nvprof` or Nsight.
Ana P: Uploaded a short log; also saw occasional inf/nan on step 2 before fallback to fp16. Not deterministic.
Miguel: That nondeterminism smells like an uninitialized scale or race in kernel init for FP8 accumulators. We had a similar issue in an older AWQ patch.
zoe-ci: CI run 1841122401 completed: perf numbers and per-layer accuracy map attached. Layer 17 and 18 show 0.6 logits shift on H100 FP8 path. AWQ/GPTQ runs don't show that.
Samir: Can you diff the kernel selection table between H100 and L40S? Maybe our compilation flags (sm_90 vs sm_80) picked different tiling that exposes activation overflow.
Miguel: Also check kepler fallback matrix: if a kernel claims support but does uneven scaling, we fallback inconsistently. Add explicit `--force-kernel awq_fp8` to rule out auto-routing.
Ana P: I forced kernel to awq_fp8 on H100 and the accuracy dip disappeared. Perf dropped ~8% though. So auto path is faster but wrong for some sequences.
Liam: This is actionable: 1) turn on stricter activation clipping in FP8 autotune, 2) add a runtime check for logits drift on first N steps and fall back to stable kernel, 3) submit infra job to reproduce on canary pool.
Samir: I'll open an RFC for a runtime gating policy (canary -> promote) and patch the kernel selector to prefer correctness over perf for sequence shapes we've flagged.
Miguel: I'll dig into kernel init race and add a small memset for scale tables — should remove nondeterminism.
zoe-ci: CI: added a smoke test that runs 10 seeded long-context prompts to catch regressions. Failing cases will block FP8 auto-rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment created: fp8-auto-kernels -> canary-pool-2 (starts 1841122460).
Ana P: Thanks everyone. Next steps: Samir + Miguel to PR kernel selector + init fix, Liam to add runtime fallback, Zoe to update CI. Will rerun bakeoff once PRs land. :thumbsup:
